name: Lendlease Group
summary: Lendlease Group operates as a real estate company in Australia, Singapore, Malaysia, China, Japan, the United Kingdom, Italy, and the United States. It operates through Investments, Development, Construction, and Capital Release Unit segments. The company is involved in fund and asset management, as well as real estate co-investment portfolio activities; and creates and develops mixed-use precincts, including build to rent and build to sell apartments, and workplaces, retirement, retail, residential, commercial assets, and social and economic infrastructure.
